title: The initialized progressive drift has continuous finite-variation paths
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The initialized progressive drift has continuous finite-variation paths. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Let the scalar initial value be strongly measurable at time zero and the scalar drift be strongly progressive. Suppose its time section is integrable on the horizon almost surely. The initial value plus the drift integral is strongly progressive and has almost surely continuous finite-variation paths on the horizon. At every sample and time in the horizon it equals the initialized primitive computed with the fixed horizon measure.
